messages.author: 34d1b12964c01466
messages.subject: Long "Pending" status
parts:
Hello- I deployed earlier today (about four hours ago) but my app is still showing as status "pending" under my shinyapps.io dashboard.

After waiting an hour or so, I tried update.packages() to ensure I didn't have anything obsolete and redeployed, but nothing was different.

Here is the complete screen dump from my (re)deploy:

> deployApp('~/my_app3/', appName = 'HSPO_beta')
Preparing to deploy application...
Update application currently deployed at
http://arjunacap.shinyapps.io/HSPO_beta? [Y/n] Y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 19612...
Waiting for task: 1458697
  building: Parsing manifest
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 1458698 failed: Error parsing manifest: Manifest file data/~$Rose.xlsx checksum mismatch

messages.author: 34d1b12964c01466
messages.subject: Re: Long "Pending" status
parts:
I see now that the manifest file error mentioned at the end of the log is in fact fatal, having successfully deployed a separate app.  I hadn't realized that one could deploy to 'pending' with such an issue, indefinitely so, apparently.

Still, I could use help diagnosing the manifest parsing issue; I have no .xlsx file that I'm attempting to upload as part of the app.

I apologize for the multiple post.

I love this community and the Shiny framework.  Thank you.
